items.briefing:
A new study by 1Password has found that AI-generated security patches fail to fully fix software vulnerabilities around half the time — a timely reminder not to over-rely on AI tools for critical security tasks without human review. Locally, DXC Technology and Primary have launched an AI-powered Zero Trust security service aimed at Australian organisations, reflecting growing investment in smarter access controls.

**Practical tip:** If your team uses AI tools to help fix or identify security issues, always have a qualified person review the output before applying changes — AI can miss things that matter.

featured.title: Secureframe launches hosted AI server for compliance
featured.quote: Australian defence contractors can reduce compliance burden using AI-powered tools for federal requirements.
